Markets.title: US Stock Market: Nvidia earnings to test AI boom as markets brace for sharp move
Markets.summary: Options trading suggests Nvidia’s upcoming second-quarter earnings report will trigger a 5.4% change in its stock price, representing a potential $280 billion swing in market value. This expected movement is smaller than historical averages, indicating that investors anticipate fewer dramatic surprises as the artificial intelligence boom matures.

Markets.title: Global Market: Ueda’s Jackson Hole absence puts focus on BOJ’s September rate decision
Markets.summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda's absence from the Jackson Hole meeting has shifted market focus to other bank officials for monetary policy clues. Economists and investors are increasingly expecting the BOJ to raise its policy rate to 1.25% in September.

Markets.title: MTAR Tech shares rally 3%, extend gains for second session. What’s triggering the surge?
Markets.summary: MTAR Technologies shares rose 3% after securing a Rs 127 crore order from the Nuclear Power Corporation of India. This order pushes the company's civil nuclear order book past Rs 775 crore as it anticipates 80% revenue growth in FY27.

Markets.title: Gold prices rise marginally; silver rebounds Rs 2,000/kg as traders await US inflation data. Key levels to track
Markets.summary: MCX gold futures rose by Rs 320 to Rs 1,63,202 per 10 grams and silver gained Rs 2,053 to Rs 2,46,180 per kg on Wednesday. Prices increased as traders awaited upcoming US PCE inflation data for clues regarding the Federal Reserve's future interest rate decisions.

Markets.title: Global Market: Japan stocks rise ahead of Nvidia earnings, US inflation data
Markets.summary: Japanese stocks rose on Wednesday, with the Nikkei 225 up 0.56% and the Topix gaining 0.61%. Investors are closely monitoring upcoming Nvidia earnings and U.S. inflation data to gauge trends in artificial intelligence spending and future Federal Reserve policy.

Geo-Political.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
Geo-Political.summary: Canada is imposing retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on various American goods, including steel, furniture, tuna, and makeup. This move escalates the ongoing trade war between the United States and Canada with dollar-for-dollar levies.

Geo-Political.summary: Law enforcement conducted a global crackdown targeting West African cyber-crime networks. The operation resulted in 39 arrests in South Africa alone for romance and investment scams.

Geo-Political.summary: A recent study found that at least 25 percent of former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 suffered from a degenerative brain disease. Researchers note that the actual rate among deceased players is likely much higher.

Data & Insights.summary: India plans to add 100 new ships to its fleet to reduce its $75 billion foreign freight bill. This expansion addresses a major economic challenge, as operating under the Indian flag is currently 16% to 20% more expensive than operating under foreign flags.

Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India stated in its August bulletin that the country's strong macroeconomic foundation is protecting it from global economic shocks and trade tariffs.
